summary: Enhance your skills with our Knowledge Management Training Course. Learn effective strategies to capture, share, and utilize knowledge in your organization.
lede: Knowledge management is the practice of identifying, capturing, organizing, and sharing expertise so it can be used across an organization. This course is for professionals responsible for information flow and preserving organizational expertise, and addresses the practical task of making knowledge easier to find and reuse. Learners practice conducting knowledge audits, capturing tacit expertise, designing taxonomies, and setting up knowledge-sharing communities.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the flow of information and the preservation of expertise within their organizations.
modules: Foundations of Knowledge Management and ISO 30401
Capturing Tacit Knowledge and the SECI Model
Knowledge Sharing and Communities of Practice
KM Strategy Integration and Roadmap Development
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in a management, information technology, or operational role. Familiarity with basic organizational structures and digital workplace tools is recommended. No prior knowledge of ISO 30401 is required.
